title: Stage 5.4 Amendment 3 — TS-4 BBox-Aware Constrained EMA Smoke
research_question: Can fixed alpha=0.5 EMA retain its temporal benefit when spatial safety is changed, as the only scientific variable, from primary-center containment to parameter-free maximum visible coverage of the current frozen Stage 5.2 primary bbox?
scientific_rationale: TS-3 proves center containment but still clips primary-subject edges: containment=1.0 coexists with visible>=0.90 equal to TS-1 and strong visibility failure on both Full Dev166 and Dev142. Center-only safety is therefore scientifically insufficient. TS-4 directly optimizes the already-frozen bbox visibility diagnostic without a learned threshold, margin, sweep, or result-fitted constant.

A_center_containment.decision: rejected as scientifically insufficient by TS-3 Formal

B_full_bbox_when_feasible.meaning: full containment only when a discrete solution exists

C_parameter_free_maximum_visible_bbox.meaning: maximize bbox intersection area, then minimize distance from TS-1
C_parameter_free_maximum_visible_bbox.bbox_larger_than_crop: place crop in the discrete maximum-overlap set

ts4_algorithm.name: bbox_aware_constrained_ema_v1
objective: maximize current frozen primary-bbox visible fraction
among all maximizers minimize Euclidean distance to the final integer TS-1 proposal
ts4_algorithm.symbols: Frame [0,W)x[0,H), crop top-left integer (x,y), exact crop extents Cw and Ch, sanitized float bbox B=[x1,x2)x[y1,y2), integer TS-1 proposal (xe,ye).
ts4_algorithm.one_axis_continuous_plateau: For bbox [b1,b2), crop extent C: if b2-b1<=C, P=[b2-C,b1]; otherwise P=[b1,b2-C]. Intersect P with legal real placements [0,floor(F-C)].
ts4_algorithm.one_axis_discrete_argmax: Intersect the plateau with [0,floor(F-C)]. If the real plateau lies outside this stricter integer-placement domain, its nearest legal boundary is optimal. If the clipped plateau contains integers, [ceil(Plo),floor(Phi)] is the complete integer argmax. Otherwise evaluate exactly its two adjacent legal integers and retain every equal maximum-overlap integer. If maximum overlap is zero, the complete legal integer domain is the tie set.
ts4_algorithm.projection: q4=clip(qe,L,U) independently on x/y. The 2-D intersection area factorizes into positive x/y overlaps, so the Cartesian product of the one-axis argmax sets is exactly the 2-D maximum-visible set; coordinatewise clipping is its nearest point under L2 and L1.
ts4_algorithm.bbox_le_crop: Full containment is used if and only if the discrete argmax overlap equals bbox extent. Fractional coordinates may make continuous full containment integer-infeasible; such frames deterministically use the discrete maximum-overlap rule.
ts4_algorithm.bbox_gt_crop: Full containment is impossible on that axis; maximize overlap (=crop extent when an integer crop-inside-bbox placement exists), then choose the nearest maximizing integer placement.
ts4_algorithm.frame_edge: Sanitized bbox is frozen-clamped to [0,W]x[0,H]; all maximizers are intersected with legal crop placements, hence output is never OOB.
ts4_algorithm.half_open_integer_policy: All rectangles are half-open; bbox coordinates remain frozen floats; crop x/y are integers; Fraction(str(value)) and exact Fraction crop height define ceil/floor and ties; equal discrete maxima form the argmax interval; integer proposal projection makes tie handling unique.
ts4_algorithm.fallback: No bbox guard is evaluated. Emit frozen TS-0 center crop and clear EMA state.

mechanism: TS-4 bbox visible fraction is pointwise no worse than TS-3
TS-4 strong mean visible delta is strictly better than TS-3
TS-4 visible>=0.90 rate is no worse than TS-3
TS-4 reported after-guard visibility equals its actual crop visibility and gain is nonnegative on every eligible frame
TS-4 mean displacement, mean acceleration, and >0.20 jump ratio are each no worse than TS-2

promotion_rule.name: SMOKE_PASS_TO_FORMAL
promotion_rule.rule: Formal is authorized only when every preregistered engineering, TS-4-vs-TS-0 temporal/spatial, and Amendment 3 mechanism gate passes and protocol/config identities match. Any failure, engineering exit, scientific exit 2, missing evidence, or identity drift stops before Formal.
after_failure: do not rerun a repaired Smoke

statistical_plan: Matched deterministic frame-level comparisons on the complete frozen Smoke24 development set. Gates are prespecified effect-size/guardrail rules, not null-hypothesis significance tests. No p-value shopping, optional exclusions, or post-result threshold changes.
forbidden: real execution in this preparation round
